title: Malakili
subtitle: Loving Rancor Keeper
text:
The first Creature unit you play each phase costs 1 resource less.
If a friendly Creature unit would deal damage to a friendly unit, prevent that damage.
rules: If an ability preceding "if you do" would deal damage to a friendly unit, but Malakili prevents that damage from being dealt to that unit, the effect following "if you do" still resolves.
